Found 14 items in registries @paddle:

Showing items 1-14 of 14:

- paddle-helpers (registry:lib) - Shared display types, format utilities, and payment method display for Paddle UI components. No SDK dependency — safe to install without @paddle/paddle-js. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- paddle-client (registry:lib) - Paddle.js initialization singleton, SDK type re-exports, checkout event mapper, and SDK-layer hooks used by all client-side Paddle blocks. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pricing-select-cards (registry:component) - Selectable pricing cards with localized prices from Paddle, available in stacked and grid layouts. Uses RadioGroup for single-plan selection — designed for express checkout flows. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- express-checkout (registry:block) - Mobile-first checkout experience with pricing cards and sheet-style checkout drawer. Automatically resizes based on the height of the checkout. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- billing-interval-toggle (registry:component) - Segmented control for switching between billing intervals. Renders labels automatically from interval keys (month -> Monthly, year -> Annually). Designed for pricing pages and plan selectors. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pricing-cards (registry:component) - Responsive pricing tier cards with plan name, localized price, feature list, and per-card CTA. Supports current-plan highlighting and selection state for pricing pages and plan change flows. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pricing-display (registry:block) - Pricing section with localized prices, billing interval toggle, and built-in overlay checkout. Supports current-plan highlighting and plan change selection flows via currentPriceIds and selectedPriceId props. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkout-summary (registry:component) - Order summary for inline checkout: line items, totals, recurring/trial info, and refund policy link. Compliance-ready display for Paddle inline checkout. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- inline-checkout (registry:block) - Inline checkout block with order summary, Paddle payment frame, and real-time event updates. Supports reactive item changes, plan switching, and quantity updates. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- subscription-status-card (registry:component) - Subscription overview card showing plan details, status, billing cycle, line item breakdown, discount, scheduled changes, and optional action buttons. Supports single and multi-item subscriptions, past-due alerts, collection mode indicators, and configurable badge position. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- subscription-alert (registry:component) - Contextual alerts for subscription events: payment failures, scheduled cancellations, pauses, trials. Derives the correct alert from subscription state automatically. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- subscription-payment-card (registry:component) - Payment method and next billing summary card. Auto-resolves payment method display labels from Paddle type/brand/last4 fields. Shows next payment amount, date, and portal link to update payment details. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plan-change-preview (registry:component) - Compact plan change summary card with side-by-side plan comparison, proration breakdown, upgrade/downgrade badge, discount, scheduled change warning, and optional confirm/cancel actions. Decision-support view for plan change flows. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plan-change-breakdown (registry:component) - Detailed financial breakdown of a subscription plan change. Invoice-style view with per-transaction line items, proration periods, tax, credits, and totals for immediate, next, and recurring billing. Financial-transparency view complementing the compact plan-change-preview. [@paddle] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
